answer_2.quote: To evaluate speaker similarity (SPK) between the original prompt and synthesized speech, we employ WavLM-TDNN ... For assessing automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance, we conduct ASR on the generated audio and calculate the word error rate (WER) ... We measure the ratio of the total length of generated speech to the total time taken by the model to generate the corresponding speech features ... the real-time factor (RTF).

answer_4.quote: We conduct the MOS (mean opinion score) and CMOS (comparative mean opinion score) evaluation on the test set to measure the audio naturalness via crowdsourcing. ... each audio is listened to by at least 20 testers.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were asked to rate audio on three MOS aspects: MOS-Q (quality: clarity, high-frequency, timbre), MOS-P (prosody: pitch, energy, duration), MOS-S (speaker similarity). CMOS was used to compare audio quality and speech prosody between systems.
